source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Δαμιανός εκ Γεωργίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page's head line reads «Οσιος Δαμιανος Εκ Γεωργιας (; - 1156)». **He is not the corpus's `demetrius-of-georgia`**, although both were kings of Georgia called Demetrius and both are honoured: that folder is Demetre the Devoted, great-grandson of Queen Tamar, whose mother Gvantsa and father David V the Mongols killed and who was himself martyred, and the Romanian calendar keeps him on 16 martie; this one is the son of David II the Strong or Restorer, reigned from 1125, laid down his crown, became a monk under the name Damian and fell asleep in peace in 1156. `king` is kept in `types` beside `venerable` and `monk` because the page says outright that he was king of the Georgians. His father has no folder: the corpus's `david-of-georgia` is the martyr of 740. No hymn, no relics.
